items.title: Release v0.28.3
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code ships v0.28.3, hardening end-to-end verification for scheduled loop tasks and the state guards in PR checks, along with container and VM refinements.
Claude Code 2.1.330 adds enterprise admin console sign-in, a built-in chart-drawing mod called easel, and several self-hosted runner and plugin install improvements.

items.title: Kiro cloud sessions now reach private networks
items.en_title: Kiro cloud sessions now reach private networks
items.en_oneliner: Once an admin configures a VPC, Kiro cloud sessions can join a company's private network and use internal services and resources directly, without moving code out of it.

items.title: Remote workspaces bring the IDE to where your code and compute already live
items.en_title: Remote workspaces bring the IDE to where your code and compute already live
items.en_oneliner: Kiro IDE can now open a workspace in a cloud session, a local dev container, or on a remote host, so the development environment follows wherever the code and compute already are.

items.title: Agents SDK v1.0.0-alpha.1
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's Agents SDK ships its first 1.0 preview, letting Python developers use Codex as an optional model provider.

items.title: Release v0.28.1-preview.1
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code ships v0.28.1-preview.1, fixing watch-state guards and container nonce handling in PR verification and adding end-to-end coverage for a managed agent's scheduled loop.

items.title: Introducing Kiro for VS Code
items.en_oneliner: Kiro has landed in VS Code for macOS, Windows, and Linux, letting developers use the Kiro agent without leaving the editor.
